🌊 Did you know? On the southern Brazilian coast the water can turn suddenly colder in the middle of summer: persistent north-easterly winds push the warm surface layer offshore and cold, nutrient-rich water rises from below to replace it. That upwelling is why a January swim can feel like July. [source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Upwelling]
